expected.fmt:
import expect_true from "@std/test/test.ms"

fn twice(n: Int) Int: n * 2

type Options:
	count: Int
	total: Int = count + 1
	label: String = "x"
	scale: Float = 1.5
	scaled: Int = twice(n: total)

type Plain:
	name: String = "p"
	size: Int = 3

test "constructors":
	a := Options(count: 5)
	expect_true((a.total == 6 and a.label == "x" and a.scale == 1.5 and a.scaled == 12))?

	b := Options(count: 5, total: 0)
	expect_true((b.total == 0 and b.scaled == 0))?

	c := Options(count: 1, total: 2, label: "y", scale: 2.0, scaled: 9)
	expect_true((c.label == "y" and c.scaled == 9 and c.scale == 2.0))?

	d := Options(label: "z", count: 4)
	expect_true((d.label == "z" and d.total == 5))?

	e := Plain()
	expect_true((e.name == "p" and e.size == 3))?
	expect_true((Plain(size: 9).size == 9 and Plain(size: 9).name == "p"))?
